newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine peso dollar trading closed Nov 22, 25.
newsitem.headline: Philippine peso dollar trading closed Nov 22, 25.

text.p: The Bankers Association of the Philippines (BAP) said on Thursday there will be no trading on the Philippine Dealing System (PDS) on November 22 and 25 in view of the Asia Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) meeting.
PDS is the computerised peso-dollar trading system used by commercial banks.
"PDS transactions done on 21st November 1996 will be for value 26 November 1996," the BAP advisory said.
Bankers, however, said money market operations and trading in cross currencies such as the dollar, yen and mark would remain open during those days.
